questions.stem: Among the following statements about folliculogenesis, which is (are) correct?
options: About 1 million follicles are present at birth
The secondary follicle contains a secondary oocyte
Folliculogenesis begins from the 7th month of pregnancy
The mature follicle contains the first polar body

questions.stem: Among the following statements about male meiosis, which is (are) correct?
options: It is preceded by a differentiation phase
Each secondary spermatocyte enters meiosis II (equational division)
One primary spermatocyte gives 16 spermatids at the end of meiosis
Meiosis II is completed at fertilization

questions.stem: About the figure (histological section):
options: It is a pre-antral follicle
At the center of the structure lies the secondary oocyte blocked in metaphase II
At the periphery a fibrous theca interna is recognized
The structure has just undergone a hormonal surge (FSH, LH)
questions.explanation: A mature (pre-ovulatory) Graafian follicle; the theca interna is glandular, the theca externa fibrous.

questions.stem: Among the following statements about the hypothalamo-pituitary-gonadal axis, which is (are) correct?
options: The hypothalamus secretes hCG
Inhibin exerts negative feedback on testosterone secretion
Pituitary FSH stimulates Sertoli cells
Progesterone is mainly secreted in the pre-ovulatory phase

questions.stem: Concerning Sertoli cells, which statement(s) is (are) correct?
options: They secrete AMH, which feeds back on the hypothalamo-pituitary axis when sperm count is high
They supply nutrients to Leydig cells
They remove the cytoplasm of secondary spermatocytes
They form a protective barrier for cells in meiosis against the immune system

questions.stem: Among the following statements about the endometrial reaction to implantation (decidual reaction), which is (are) correct?
options: It occurs on the 12th day of embryonic development
If the reaction is very strong, the zygote is rejected and the pregnancy stops
The decidua designate the part of the myometrium formed after the decidual reaction, eliminated after delivery
The three decidua formed persist until the end of pregnancy

questions.stem: Concerning the diagram (figure), which statement(s) is (are) correct?
options: It shows the phenomenon of spermatogenesis
It corresponds to the transformation of a spermatid into a spermatozoon
Element 10 results from the accumulation of elements 2 and 3
This phenomenon lasts 74 days
questions.explanation: Spermiogenesis: the acrosome (10) forms from Golgi vesicles.

questions.stem: To enter the oocyte, the capacitated spermatozoon must successively cross:
options: The zona pellucida, the corona radiata, the cumulus oophorus and the oocyte plasma membrane
The zona pellucida, the cumulus oophorus, the corona radiata and the oocyte plasma membrane
The cumulus oophorus, the oocyte plasma membrane, the zona pellucida and the corona radiata
The cumulus oophorus, the corona radiata, the zona pellucida and the oocyte plasma membrane

questions.stem: Concerning the indifferent genital system:
options: The Wolffian ducts degenerate in the male
The Müllerian ducts degenerate in the male
Its primordium appears at the end of the 3rd week
The male needs primordial gonocytes to synthesize anti-Müllerian hormone (AMH)

questions.stem: Concerning the decidua (caducous membranes):
options: They designate the part of the endometrium formed after the decidual reaction
They are eliminated after delivery
The parietal decidua lies around the embryo and accompanies it as it grows
At the end of pregnancy two decidua are observed
questions.explanation: The stem is cut off on the scan. The decidua capsularis (not parietalis) surrounds the embryo.

questions.stem: Among the statements about the primitive streak, which assertion(s) is (are) correct?
options: It is set up at the beginning of the 3rd week of development
It forms a cellular groove along the cephalo-caudal axis of the embryo
It is bounded posteriorly by Hensen's node
It is followed by the appearance of the mesoblast

questions.stem: All these implantations are ectopic except one:
options: Tubal
Pelvic
Cervical
Uterine

questions.stem: The placenta secretes all these hormones except one:
options: Progesterone
Estrogen
hCG
Inhibin

questions.stem: Gametogenesis includes all these phases except one:
options: Proliferation
Multiplication
Cell division
Growth

questions.stem: Concerning the development of somites, tick the correct answer(s):
options: The first somites appear on day 24
2 to 3 pairs of somites appear per day
All somites are in place by day 28
Somites are metameric structures

questions.stem: Which statement(s) about the diagram (figure) is (are) correct?
options: It is an embryo at the trabecular (lacunar) stage
Arrow 2 points to the uterine cavity
Arrow 3 points to the follicular cavity
The didermic disc lies between two cavities

questions.stem: Among the embryological elements below, which one(s) has (have) an inductive effect?
options: Primordial gonocytes
The allantoic diverticulum
The neural tube
The neural plate

questions.stem: Meiosis takes place during the phase of:
options: Differentiation
Maturation
Growth
Multiplication

questions.stem: Among the following statements about the delimitation (folding) process, which is (are) correct?
options: Delimitation occurs at the same time as organogenesis
Delimitation individualizes the embryo from its annexes
Delimitation is accompanied by the setting up of the mesoblast
It transforms the didermic embryonic disc into a tridermic disc

questions.stem: What is the approximate age of an embryo with 44 pairs of somites?
options: 26 days
30 days
35 days
40 days

questions.stem:
Put the stages of the evolution of the human placenta in the exact order:
A – The villi spread and form a cytotrophoblastic shell.
B – The trophoblast emits the syncytiotrophoblast, then turns into cytotrophoblast.
C – The syncytiotrophoblast hollows out lacunae that will contain maternal blood.
D – At the end of the third month, all parts of the chorion degenerate except, where the umbilical cord is implanted, the villi that form the placenta.
Choose the right combination:
options: A B C D
B C D A
C A B D
B C A D

questions.stem: About diagram X (figure), indicate the correct answer(s):
options: It represents an embryo at the end of the 4th week
The approximate age of this embryo is 35 days
At this stage the anterior neuropore is closed
At this stage the primitive umbilical cord is formed by the end of the allantois, the vitelline duct and the yolk sac

questions.stem: Concerning the same diagram X (figure):
options: Element 1 represents the umbilical cord
Element 2 is of ectoblastic origin
Element 3 plays an essential role in setting up the vascular elements
Element 4 is set up in the 2nd week of embryonic development

questions.stem: The "most identical" identical twins have the following characteristic(s):
options: Monozygotic diamniotic monochorionic
Monozygotic monoamniotic monochorionic
Monozygotic diamniotic dichorionic
Intolerance to cross-grafts

questions.stem: About the diagram (figure), indicate the correct answer(s):
options: It is a phenomenon characteristic of the 2nd week of development
It is hatching
It is the beginning of blastocyst adhesion to the endometrium
It is the formation of the secondary yolk sac (lecithocele)
